title: Upgrading and migrating PostgreSQL
brief: Choose and rehearse a PostgreSQL upgrade or migration with a recoverable write handover.
outcomes: Distinguish in-place major upgrade from logical migration
Validate compatibility, cutover and the point of no easy return
entry: Backups, logical replication, schema compatibility and authority fencing.

heading.title: What is changing
heading.brief: Separate minor updates, major-version format changes, host moves and extension compatibility; inventory drivers, collations, extensions and operational dependencies.

heading.title: A route through the change
heading.brief: Compare pg_upgrade, dump/restore and logical replication by downtime, capacity, validation and reversal constraints.

heading.title: A fenced rehearsal
heading.brief: Pin source and target versions, rehearse an owned dump/restore with write freeze and complete roles, sequences and schema dependencies.

heading.title: Acceptance and return
heading.brief: Verify application queries and writes as runtime roles, compare meaningful data and performance, then transfer authority; account for target-only work before rollback.
